create.name: Kim Krans
create.bio:
Kim Krans is an artist and author best known for The Wild Unknown, a family of hand-drawn oracle and tarot decks. She drew and self-published the first Wild Unknown Tarot in 2012; four years later HarperCollins released it with a guidebook and it became a New York Times bestseller, followed by Animal Spirit, Archetypes and Alchemy decks. Her black-and-white line drawings of animals, plants and symbols have made the decks some of the most widely used in contemporary tarot.

She trained as an artist, with a BFA in drawing from Cooper Union and an MFA from Hunter College, and later studied Jungian depth psychology and creativity at master's level at Pacifica Graduate Institute. Her own seeking has taken her to India, Africa, Europe and the UK to study Eastern philosophy and shamanic practice. Alongside drawing she works as a performer and musician, and she teaches workshops and live online courses that use art, meditation and Jungian dreamwork as tools for creative and inner change. She has also recorded a set of guided meditations on the cards of the Major Arcana and created Renunciation, a playful board game about karma and letting go.
